episode_event_pm1004_00_00/6801_1031_100:
Do people never change?
Or is it possible?
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/6801_1001_200:
I too want to believe hope remains for the
future.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/6801_1001_300:
However, the flames of envy burn and are
not easily quenched.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_100:
From our survey, we learned Chien-Pao was
captured by Team Plasma.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_200: The other three still haven’t been spotted.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_300:
That’s enough for me to work with. Thanks
for the report.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_400:
I suppose that means you are unaware of
what I was trying to accomplish.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_500:
Team Flare has tasked all our members with
protecting Chi-Yu.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_700: That Pokémon is a treasure of ruin?!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_800:
I’ve heard you know a lot about these
ruinous Pokémon.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_900:
If you don’t mind, could you teach me more
about Chi-Yu?
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_100:
Sure. I appreciate that you’re trying to keep
it safe.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_110:
Chi-Yu is a set of curved beads that sparked
many conflicts. Envy accumulated within
those beads...
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_120:
and that envy clad itself in fire and became
a Pokémon—or so they say.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_130: Envy... So that’s Chi-Yu’s true form.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_140: According to the legends, at least.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_150: I was right to take it in, then.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_160:
Had I left Chi-Yu to fend for itself, foolish
humans would have fought over it.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_170:
I shudder to think how that would affect
Chi-Yu, the very embodiment of envy,
enshrouded in flames.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_180:
How kind of you. Were you really that
worried for Chi-Yu?
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_200:
With Chi-Yu in my custody, fewer people
will see it...
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_210:
and the chances of it causing conflict will be
much lower.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_230:
Conflicts will happen sooner or later, even
without Chi-Yu there to spark them.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_250:
History has proven people will always find a
reason to fight.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_260: Spoken like a true history teacher, I suppose.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_280:
People can learn from the past. Many have
tried not to repeat their foolish mistakes.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_320:
But we’d be wrong to judge people by only
their mistakes. They’re only one part of us!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_340: We can leave the history lesson at that.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_350:
So about these ruinous Pokémon...
So far, we know where two of them are.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_360:
Yup! It sounds like Chien-Pao is with
Team Plasma.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_370:
I have no idea why, but it seems to trust
Ghetsis.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_380: (Trust? That’s hard to believe, knowing him.)
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4001_1001_390: (I’ll have to see this for myself.)
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4002_1001_100: You kept your word—only wanting to chat.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4002_1001_200:
Perhaps it was presumptuous of me to worry
you’d be so insolent as to stage an ambush.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4002_1001_600: I hear it placed a great deal of trust in you.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_100: Trust? Preposterous! I’m merely USING it!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_200:
Chien-Pao just happens to share my
penchant for taking hatred out on others!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_300:
I must admit, it would be a shame to lose
such a useful tool.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_500:
If it had no utility, I wouldn’t have kept it in
the first place.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_800:
I don’t think I’ve ever encountered someone
as despicable as you.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_110:
I only agreed to meet so I could take
Chi-Yu!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_120: Now hand it over, without any fuss!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_140:
I cannot allow Chien-Pao to remain with
the likes of you!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_150: Allow us to assist you, Lord Ghetsis.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_170: Myah-ha-ha-ha! Is that all you can do?!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_180:
Doesn’t Team Flare believe in your dream of
creating a “beautiful world” free of conflict?
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_190:
Such a pity you seem too weak to make it
happen!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_200:
Must I fight to create a world without
conflict?
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_230:
For some time, I’ve suppressed this feeling,
due to a promise I made a friend.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_250:
my desire for a beautiful world has
overtaken me!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_260:
Deep in my heart, the flames of my
convictions blaze!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_270: Hmph! They’ve gained the upper hand.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4003_1001_280:
I’ll retreat for now. But one day, Chi-Yu
WILL be mine!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_100: (If such foul people exist even on Pasio...)
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_400: Serena and Greninja are totally in sync! ♪
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_600: You pulled ahead of me, but I’ll catch up!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_800:
It’s great how you two strengthen each other
as you aim higher!
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_900: Well... Perhaps it is still too early to judge.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_100: Power that is too strong can corrupt humans.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_110:
I suppose when I am with Chi-Yu, my own
heart is put to the test.
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_120: It is because of such foolish humans...
episode_event_pm1004_00_00/4004_1001_130:
that I must do what only I can—for both a
beautiful Pasio and those with righteous
hearts!
